evidence.description: The update decision reads the last-news timestamp directly from User.shared.
Saving updates User.shared.news directly, demonstrating an operational, mutable dependency rather than a shared constant.

candidates.explanation: News directly accesses User.shared to read and update news persistence metadata instead of receiving that dependency through an explicit, replaceable boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: A detached task synchronously reads file contents using Data(contentsOf:).
Another detached task performs a synchronous file write using write(to:options:).

candidates.explanation: The detached tasks perform synchronous file I/O that blocks their executing threads. Task.detached does not turn these blocking reads and writes into suspending operations or move them off Swift's cooperative executor.
candidates.title: Blocking Operation in Async Context
